segmenti.tekst: …alamin, was-salatu was-salamu 'ala nabiyyina Muhammadin wa 'ala alihi wa sahbihi ajma'in. Allah, subhanahu wa ta'ala (glorified and exalted is He), says: “Innama ya'muru masajidallahi man amana billahi wal-yawm al-akhiri wa aqama as-salata wa ata az-zakata wa lam yakhsha illallah, fa 'asa ula'ika an yakunu min al-muhtadin.” Indeed, the masjids of Allah, the mosques of Allah, are maintained only by those who believe in Allah, who believe in Allah and in the Hereafter, who perform the prayer, give zakah and fear no one except Allah, subhanahu wa ta'ala – and such are rightly guided, such are rightly guided.

We see, dear brothers, what a blessing it is to maintain the houses of Allah. Maintaining the houses of Allah, subhanahu wa ta'ala, is a great, great blessing and a great honor, and see how Allah, subhanahu wa ta'ala, in this verse praises those who maintain the houses of Allah.

He praises those who maintain the houses of Allah. In today's times, when many people just perform the prayer in the mosque and leave the mosque without asking: “Is anything needed, does anything need help for the mosque, something to give,” and so on and so forth, there are also people who give the mosque priority over their own work. When I was coming to be the imam here, in this mosque, everyone told me: “Where are you going,” they said, “[unclear] down to Jalija…”

this and that, you know those old stories. But believe me, when I came here to Jalija, I found the complete opposite: that there is hardly a man who has not offered help for the mosque, that there is hardly a man in this congregation… There are even people who come only for Jumu'ah, but when you call him, he is there immediately, there immediately. Not to mention our members of the congregation who are regulars – that is, they are always here, in the middle of the day, in the middle of the night. But

one man, believe me, has stood out in this regard, and that is our brother Sead Gigo, whom you all know, the president of our congregation committee, whom we, as a congregation, wanted to delight with an umrah, in sha Allah, on which he will, in sha Allah, go – go now on the first, in sha Allah, of, well, January – with the shaykh, imam [unclear] Islamović, in sha Allah, and he will stay in Mecca and in Medina. I ask Allah, subhanahu wa ta'ala, to accept his good deeds

and his efforts. Believe me, I often recall his example; it seems to me similar to the example of the companions, of whom it is said: “And they give others preference over themselves, even though they themselves are in need.” That is, a person… we are all in need of providing for our families, but believe me, that man, when there is something for the mosque and I call him, leaves his work, leaves his work to come and finish something for the mosque, what I asked of him.

And all of it by agreement, and in a pleasant agreement. I ask Allah, subhanahu wa ta'ala, to accept his umrah. I ask Allah, subhanahu wa ta'ala, to reward all of you who took part in this beautiful project, and I also ask Allah to reward you because together we look after the mosque, which is truly, I can say, one of the best congregations in Pazar.

That is, if not beyond. Such a beautiful harmony, such a beautiful atmosphere lives in this mosque. I ask Allah, subhanahu wa ta'ala, only to improve our condition even more and to set us right, and that we, in sha Allah, grow more and more, in sha Allahu ta'ala. I ask Allah, subhanahu wa ta'ala, to be pleased with us, to unite us in Jannah (Paradise) as He has united us in this place. Amin, ya Rabb al-alamin. Gigo, please, come, [unclear].
